description: Deal-level underwrite assumptions (the dials the analyst sets once per deal). Validated by the underwrite runner. Any value left null falls back to the house default and is flagged in Mode A so the analyst can confirm or override before Mode B computes returns.
notes: Mirrors the engine's deal-level human-input fields (C:\MLI build spec section 12) and the interface contract. Yields/rates/growth are decimals (0.0625 = 6.25%). These are NOT extracted from the tenancy schedule; they are the analyst's pricing view.

columns.name: entry_date
columns.notes: Acquisition / cashflow start date. Drives the engine entry-date rewiring.

columns.name: hold_years
columns.notes: Hold period in years (engine CFO Q26). Exit date = entry + hold. Fractional holds supported.

columns.name: entry_yield
columns.notes: Acquisition NIY (decimal). PRICING DECISION - confirm, do not just take the schedule NIY. If null, the engine uses the per-unit schedule yields.

columns.name: exit_yield
columns.notes: Exit NIY (decimal). The single biggest value driver. Newbury used 0.0625.

columns.name: rental_growth
columns.notes: Universal annual ERV growth (decimal), anchored to the fixed valuation date so entry-date moves do not change growth magnitude.

columns.name: post_exit_growth
columns.notes: Growth assumed for the next buyer after our exit (two-rate kink). Feeds the Next Buyer CF.

columns.name: exit_basis
columns.notes: Value the exit on passing rent (conservative house default) or ERV (lifts the exit materially). Offer, do not switch silently.

columns.name: debt_rate
columns.notes: All-in debt rate (decimal, SONIA + margin ~6%). Null = engine default.

columns.name: tax_scenario
columns.notes: Tax/structure scenario. reit_exempt removes exit CGT and can lift net above unlevered.

columns.name: sales_costs
columns.notes: Sale costs on exit (decimal). House default ~0.8%.

columns.name: void_mths
columns.notes: Vacant-at-entry re-let void (engine I8). Mid-hold vacate/break re-lets default 9 if the schedule is blank.

columns.name: rent_free_mths
columns.notes: Vacant-at-entry re-let rent-free (engine I9). Mid-hold default 6 if blank.

columns.name: reletting_capex_psf
columns.notes: Re-let capex (GBP psf) default on vacate/break units when the schedule is blank.

columns.name: letting_fee_pct
columns.notes: Letting fee on ERV applied in the vacant-entry deduction (engine I11).

columns.name: empty_rates_relief_mths
columns.notes: Empty-rates relief period before void rates are charged (engine L8).
